quotes.author: Duane Perreault
quotes.text: My wife, her sister and I took a tour on Winter Harbor's pristine waters with Clearwater Lodges very own Josh de Beer. We've been vacationing on the lake for 29 years, whether in kayaks, boats we hauled there, or the Millie B. Josh shared history we were unaware of with the flourish of one who's lived it and loves it. An hour and a half flew by, making us aware that our next trip will be longer, perhaps with a lovely sunset at the end. Thanks Josh!

quotes.author: Samantha Steinhage
quotes.text: Couldn’t have asked for a better experience with Josh and Clearwater Boat Charters! The boat was so clean and spacious and Josh told us so many interesting stories about the lake and the homes in it! My daughter has an amazing time too. Not pictured in the photo is the life jacket my daughter refused to wear… haha. Thank you Josh! Can’t wait to come back!

quotes.author: Ray Smith
quotes.text: Clearwater Boat Charters provides an amazing experience. From the moment we stepped aboard the incredibly comfortable tri-hull it was an experience we won’t forget. The captain took us on tour of spectacular Winter Harbor, describing points of interest along the way. Would highly recommend.

quotes.author: Jörg Steinhage
quotes.text: We had an amazing time cruising the lake with our family and friends. The Tritoon boat is super comfortable and steady like a big floating lounge. I would highly recommend going with Clearwater Boat Charters. Josh is a local and super knowledgeable on the area. We will be back!

quotes.author: Sharon
quotes.text: Cruising with Clearwater Boat Charters was a great experience! We have been to Wolfeboro many times but got a brand new perspective seeing this area from the water. Beautiful! would highly recommend to first timers or seasoned visitors.
